description: Public text and complete schema contract. Recall/review inputs retain reviewed 2.0.8 changes; recall modes retain reviewed 2.0.9 changes and the one-call Normal fallback when Discussion has no eligible historical sessions. Storage help/schema/fields and the shared OKF path sentence reflect reviewed 2.0.10 storage unification. Guide changes include reviewed editor/storage sections, section numbering, the storage JSON field, removal of startup history synchronization, and the separately approved post-setup import step. The configuration command description and direct-editor guide also reflect reviewed now-value rows. The command description includes read-only database session management and explicit session deletion by inclusive turn count. The independent write_okf tool and shared OKF/transient guidance reflect current-context writing without historical retrieval. Setup tool metadata, setup notices, backfill approval help and the saved response include the separately approved post-setup import step. History tool descriptions and shared OKF/active guidance include the reviewed evidence -> comparison -> successful save -> final answer workflow and resaving after additional evidence. The four shared workflow notices are fingerprinted separately. The three save tools include reviewed optional meeting_id and shared append guidance. Inspect/recall metadata and knowledge-first guidance distinguish explicit additions from saved-document reuse. Append guidance is fingerprinted separately. Other tool metadata, environment help, model text and the read response retain earlier baselines. Shared guidance is shortened with shared tool identifiers. All 15 tool names, complete schemas, labels, execution modes and snippets match the prior baseline. Tool descriptions and guidelines change only through the reviewed shared guidance. The saved setup response changes only its shared import notice. SHA-256 over canonical JSON. The default knowledge path is normalized for portability. No events or tools were executed.
